title: Law of Definite (Constant) Proportions — Statement
notes: **Statement:** a given chemical compound always contains its constituent elements combined together in the same fixed proportion by mass, regardless of the source of the compound or the method used to prepare it
This is verified experimentally by checking that the percentage composition of an element stays constant across independently prepared samples of the same compound
